text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My body was frail and there were days I 
couldn't run at all, but thanks to my mom, 
dad, and the doctor, I've finally made it 
to the starting line.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's why from here on—I want to win 
races and repay everyone. Trainer, I look 
forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
